summaryJa: 機密 (SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY) MISREP 10194673。任務は2024年7月14日（DTG表記）に実施。機体（表記は赤字化/1.4a） は140222ZJUL24に離陸し140300ZJUL24にステーション到着。140334Z–140925Zにかけて38P MT 51DD付近でNAVCENT支援の目標開発を実施。140517ZJUL24に38P付近でUAPを1件観測（直線飛行、同高度維持、観測者評価は“良性/Benign”）。UAPの推進手段や有意な署名は不明、センサーによる応答・尋問なし、人的被害・機材影響なし、物質回収なし。141041Z–142130Zに再タスクされAFCENT支援の目標開発を38P MV 24D付近で実施。142142Zにステーション離脱、142238Zにハンドバック、142259Z着陸。フルモーションビデオ(FMV)は解析済み。事前調整はNAVCENTに124分、AFCENTに30分でいずれも“優秀”。天候は作戦に影響なし。多くの識別情報は文書上で赤字化されている。
summaryEn: Classification: SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY. MISREP 10194673. The aircraft (identifiers redacted as 1.4a) departed at 140222ZJUL24 and arrived on station at 140300ZJUL24. From 140334Z–140925Z the asset conducted target development in support of NAVCENT near grid 38P MT 51DD. A single UAP was observed at 140517ZJUL24 near 38P (straight flight path, maintained same altitude); the observer assessed it as benign. UAP propulsion, signatures, and advanced capabilities are unknown; no sensor interrogation/returns recorded, no effects on personnel or equipment, and no material recovered. The platform was retasked from 141041Z–142130Z to support AFCENT near 38P MV 24D. Off-station at 142142Z, handed back at 142238Z, and landed at 142259Z. Full-motion video was exploited. Precoordination times: NAVCENT 124 minutes, AFCENT 30 minutes (both rated excellent). Weather did not affect IMINT. Numerous identifying details are redacted in the report.
